scientific_question: In the annular-combustor flow field, can you identify one relevant coherent constant-density spatial structure by treating each connected component of the constant-Density isosurface at the linearly interpolated 90th percentile of finite stored Density values as a candidate and selecting the component with the largest surface area? Represent the selected surface by its area-weighted centroid and surface area, and report its representative location, defining density value, and spatial extent.
